dialogues.jp: 「ふあ〜」
dialogues.en: "Fuwaaah~"
dialogues.text: "Fuwaaah~"

dialogues.jp: あくびをかみ殺しつつ、教室に入る。
dialogues.en: I entered the classroom, trying to stifle my yawn.
dialogues.text: I entered the classroom, trying to stifle my yawn.

dialogues.jp: 泣こうがわめこうが、今日はテスト当日だった。
dialogues.en:
Cry or scream however much I want, today's the day of the
exams.
dialogues.text:
Cry or scream however much I want, today's the day of the
exams.

dialogues.jp: （ま、何とかなるだろ）
dialogues.en: "(I'd make it somehow.)"
dialogues.text: "(I'd make it somehow.)"

dialogues.jp: ……たぶん。だけど。
dialogues.en: ...Or something. Although.
dialogues.text: ...Or something. Although.

dialogues.jp:
テスト勉強はあまりしてないが、普段、ちゃん
と授業は受けているし。睡眠学習という画期的
な方法で。
dialogues.en:
Even though it seems like I haven't prepared for the exams,
the true effectiveness of my sleepstudying will be shown
now.
dialogues.text:
Even though it seems like I haven't prepared for the exams,
the true effectiveness of my sleepstudying will be shown
now.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「おはようございます、朝倉様」
dialogues.en: "Good morning, Asakura-sama."
dialogues.text: "Good morning, Asakura-sama."

dialogues.jp: 朝から風のように爽やかな声が響く。
dialogues.en:
A voice as refreshing as the morning breeze floated to my
ears.
dialogues.text:
A voice as refreshing as the morning breeze floated to my
ears.

dialogues.jp: 振り返ると、環が柔らかい笑みを浮かべていた。
dialogues.en: I turned around to find Tamaki, a gentle smile on her face.
dialogues.text: I turned around to find Tamaki, a gentle smile on her face.

dialogues.jp: 「おっす」
dialogues.en: "Mornin'."
dialogues.text: "Mornin'."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「今日は早いんですね」
dialogues.en: "You're quite early today."
dialogues.text: "You're quite early today."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「一応、テストだからな。遅刻するわけにはい
　かんだろ」
dialogues.en: "It's the day of the exams. I can't be late."
dialogues.text: "It's the day of the exams. I can't be late."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「まあ、遅刻した方がよかったかもしれんがな」
dialogues.en: "...Although it might be for the best, if I was."
dialogues.text: "...Although it might be for the best, if I was."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「どうしてですか？」
dialogues.en: "Why would that be?"
dialogues.text: "Why would that be?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「中途半端な点数を取るより、いっそテストを
　受けずにおいて、追試に勝負をかけるという
　方法がある」
dialogues.en:
"You can choose to take the supplementary exam instead if
you have a good reason to be late."
dialogues.text:
"You can choose to take the supplementary exam instead if
you have a good reason to be late."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「それは何だかどっちもどっちのような気がし
　ます」
dialogues.en: "It sounds like you had trouble picking which to do."
dialogues.text: "It sounds like you had trouble picking which to do."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「かも知れん」
dialogues.en: "Perhaps."
dialogues.text: "Perhaps."

dialogues.jp: 環の苦笑に、俺も苦笑で応えた。
dialogues.en: I replied her vague insinuation with vagueness myself.
dialogues.text: I replied her vague insinuation with vagueness myself.

dialogues.jp: 「ちなみに、環はテスト勉強したのか？」
dialogues.en: "What about you? You've prepared well?"
dialogues.text: "What about you? You've prepared well?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「ええ、まあ。それなりにですけど」
dialogues.en: "Yes, you might say so."
dialogues.text: "Yes, you might say so."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「それなり……って割には、えらく余裕たっぷ
　りに見えるがな……」
dialogues.en:
"You might say so... you sound awfully confident, don't
you."
dialogues.text:
"You might say so... you sound awfully confident, don't
you."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「そうですか？」
dialogues.en: "I do?"
dialogues.text: "I do?"

dialogues.jp:
不思議そうに小首を傾げる環だったが、やはり
その表情からは勉強したものだけが見せる独特
の自信が溢れている。
dialogues.en:
She tilted her head to the side in puzzlement. These
innocent ones are always the ones who know the best ways.
dialogues.text:
She tilted her head to the side in puzzlement. These
innocent ones are always the ones who know the best ways.

dialogues.jp: むむむ。こやつ、相当できるな……。
dialogues.en: Mmm, this could be useful...
dialogues.text: Mmm, this could be useful...

dialogues.jp:
「どんなテスト勉強したんだ？　秘策があるん
　なら、是非教えてくれ」
dialogues.en:
"How do you study for the exams? You have some secret
method, don't you?"
dialogues.text:
"How do you study for the exams? You have some secret
method, don't you?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「秘策……なんでしょうか？」
dialogues.en: "Secret... method?"
dialogues.text: "Secret... method?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「教科書の全てを暗記しているんです」
dialogues.en: "I just memorize the contents of the textbook."
dialogues.text: "I just memorize the contents of the textbook."

dialogues.jp: 思わず間抜けな声を出してしまった。
dialogues.en: My voice came out sounding incredibly stupid.
dialogues.text: My voice came out sounding incredibly stupid.

dialogues.jp:
「ちょっ……ちょっと待ってくれ。全部って、
　……丸暗記か？」
dialogues.en: "H... hold up. You completely... memorize... everything?"
dialogues.text: "H... hold up. You completely... memorize... everything?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「はい」
dialogues.en: "Correct."
dialogues.text: "Correct."

dialogues.jp: にっこりと微笑む環。
dialogues.en: She gave me a big smile.
dialogues.text: She gave me a big smile.

dialogues.jp: いや、そんなに爽やかに微笑まれても。
dialogues.en:
Ugh, that kind of smile at this time of the day will
brighten my mood!
dialogues.text:
Ugh, that kind of smile at this time of the day will
brighten my mood!

dialogues.jp: 確かにそうすればテストは確実だろうけど……。
dialogues.en:
I guess that's the one surefire way of doing well for
tests...
dialogues.text:
I guess that's the one surefire way of doing well for
tests...

dialogues.jp: 「そんなことできるのか？」
dialogues.en: "You can really do that?"
dialogues.text: "You can really do that?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「ええ」
dialogues.en: "Yes."
dialogues.text: "Yes."

dialogues.jp:
環にとってはたぶん普通の、だけど、俺には余
裕の笑みにしか見えない笑顔を浮かべて答える。
dialogues.en:
Tamaki smiled again, treating it as if it's the most normal
thing in the world to do.
dialogues.text:
Tamaki smiled again, treating it as if it's the most normal
thing in the world to do.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「祝詞なんかを覚える感じでやるんです」
dialogues.en:
"It is quite similar to the memorization of the Shinto
ritual prayers."
dialogues.text:
"It is quite similar to the memorization of the Shinto
ritual prayers."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「祝詞……はあああああ、なるほど！」
dialogues.en: "Prayers.... Haaaaaaaah, I see!"
dialogues.text: "Prayers.... Haaaaaaaah, I see!"

dialogues.jp: 俺は今っ。
dialogues.en: Now,
dialogues.text: Now,

dialogues.jp: モーレツに感心しているぅっ！
dialogues.en: My admiration knows no bounds!
dialogues.text: My admiration knows no bounds!

dialogues.jp: 巫女ってすごい。
dialogues.en: Miko are really amazing.
dialogues.text: Miko are really amazing.

dialogues.jp: さすがは神の使いだぜ！
dialogues.en: They aren't God's messengers for nothing!
dialogues.text: They aren't God's messengers for nothing!

dialogues.jp: 「……って、本当かよ」
dialogues.en: "...So, it's really true?"
dialogues.text: "...So, it's really true?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「本当ですよ」
dialogues.en: "It's true."
dialogues.text: "It's true."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「よし、じゃあ試しに問題出すぞ」
dialogues.en: "Alright, then I'd test you a little."
dialogues.text: "Alright, then I'd test you a little."

dialogues.jp:
環の言葉を信じていない訳じゃないけど、ああ
も断言されると、こちらとしても確かめたくな
る。
dialogues.en:
Not that I don't believe her, but the way she pronounces
such a thing with such confidence... I have to confirm it.
dialogues.text:
Not that I don't believe her, but the way she pronounces
such a thing with such confidence... I have to confirm it.

dialogues.jp:
俺は机の中にしまいっぱなしだった教科書を取
り出して、適当なページを開いた。
dialogues.en:
I took several textbooks from under my desk and plopped them
on top, flipping to a suitable page.
dialogues.text:
I took several textbooks from under my desk and plopped them
on top, flipping to a suitable page.

dialogues.jp: 「じゃ、まずは歴史からだ」
dialogues.en: "Let's start with history."
dialogues.text: "Let's start with history."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「はい」
dialogues.en: "Okay."
dialogues.text: "Okay."

dialogues.jp: 環が少しだけ緊張した面もちになる。
dialogues.en: A bit of tension crept into her face.
dialogues.text: A bit of tension crept into her face.

dialogues.jp:
「天台宗の高僧、慈覚大師円仁によって、東北
　に弘台寿院というお寺が開かれたが、これは
　後の何というお寺か」
dialogues.en:
"The high priest of the Tendai sect, Ennin, opened a temple
in the far northeast of Japan. What was the temple called?"
dialogues.text:
"The high priest of the Tendai sect, Ennin, opened a temple
in the far northeast of Japan. What was the temple called?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「平泉の中尊寺です」
dialogues.en: "Hiraizumi no Chuusonji."
dialogues.text: "Hiraizumi no Chuusonji."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「ファイナルアンサー？」
dialogues.en: "Is that your final answer?"
dialogues.text: "Is that your final answer?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「ええ、ファイナルアンサーです」
dialogues.en: "Yes, that is my final answer."
dialogues.text: "Yes, that is my final answer."

dialogues.jp:
まるでテレビ番組のように、俺はじっくりと間
を置く。
dialogues.en:
Just like the TV show, I paused shortly before delivering
the verdict.
dialogues.text:
Just like the TV show, I paused shortly before delivering
the verdict.

dialogues.jp:
自信が漂っていた環の表情に、ほんの少しだけ
かげりが見えた瞬間。
dialogues.en:
Long enough for me to see the sheer confidence that she
possessed.
dialogues.text:
Long enough for me to see the sheer confidence that she
possessed.

dialogues.en: "--Correct!"
dialogues.text: "--Correct!"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.en: "...Whew."
dialogues.text: "...Whew."

dialogues.jp: 環がほっと胸を撫で下ろした。
dialogues.en: Tamaki patted her chest in relief.
dialogues.text: Tamaki patted her chest in relief.

dialogues.jp:
「たまたまこの答えを知っていたという可能性
　もあるよな」
dialogues.en:
"There's every chance that you could've just remembered this
question, eh?"
dialogues.text:
"There's every chance that you could've just remembered this
question, eh?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「じゃあ、次の問題を出してください」
dialogues.en: "If you think so, please move on to the next question."
dialogues.text: "If you think so, please move on to the next question."

dialogues.jp:
正解した自信からか、さっきまであった揺らぎ
が環から消えている。
dialogues.en:
With the confidence back in her after her correct answer,
her previous trembling had vanished.
dialogues.text:
With the confidence back in her after her correct answer,
her previous trembling had vanished.

dialogues.jp:
ほんのりと頬を上気させて、｛りん／凛｝と澄んだ、気持
ちいいくらい真っ直ぐな瞳で俺を見つめてくる。
dialogues.en:
Instead, her cheeks were slightly flushed from the
excitement, with those limpid eyes staring straight at me...
dialogues.text:
Instead, her cheeks were slightly flushed from the
excitement, with those limpid eyes staring straight at me...

dialogues.jp: 思わず、見とれてしまいそうだ。
dialogues.en: I was entranced by them.
dialogues.text: I was entranced by them.

dialogues.jp: 俺がぼうっと環を見ていると。
dialogues.en: All I could do was to stare back at them.
dialogues.text: All I could do was to stare back at them.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉様？」
dialogues.en: "Asakura-sama?"
dialogues.text: "Asakura-sama?"

dialogues.jp: 環が小首を傾げて、俺の顔を覗き込んできた。
dialogues.en: Tamaki become puzzled, peering closer into my face.
dialogues.text: Tamaki become puzzled, peering closer into my face.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「どうかなさったんですか？」
dialogues.en: "Is something wrong?"
dialogues.text: "Is something wrong?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「あー、いや。なんでもないぞ。うん」
dialogues.en: "Ahh, n, nothing, nothing's wrong."
dialogues.text: "Ahh, n, nothing, nothing's wrong."

dialogues.jp:
近づいてきた環から何とも言えない甘い匂いが
して、さらに胸がドキドキする。
dialogues.en:
The closer she got, the more of her sweet scent I could
smell, which drove my heart even faster.
dialogues.text:
The closer she got, the more of her sweet scent I could
smell, which drove my heart even faster.

dialogues.jp:
俺はそれを誤魔化すように、教科書に視線を落
とした。
dialogues.en:
I quickly distracted myself by returning my gaze to the
textbook.
dialogues.text:
I quickly distracted myself by returning my gaze to the
textbook.

dialogues.jp: 「じゃ……じゃあもう一問だ」
dialogues.en: "Then... another question."
dialogues.text: "Then... another question."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「はい」
dialogues.en: "Yes."
dialogues.text: "Yes."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「小説『蒲団』は、誰が作者で、何派に属する
　か？」
dialogues.en:
"Who is the author of the book "Futon", and what genre is
it?"
dialogues.text:
"Who is the author of the book "Futon", and what genre is
it?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「田山花袋作で、自然主義派ですね」
dialogues.en:
"The author is Tayama Katai, and it is under the naturalism
genre."
dialogues.text:
"The author is Tayama Katai, and it is under the naturalism
genre."

dialogues.jp: ……正解だ。
dialogues.en: ...Correct.
dialogues.text: ...Correct.

dialogues.jp: 「次。印象派について説明せよ」
dialogues.en: "Next... explain about impressionists."
dialogues.text: "Next... explain about impressionists."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「フランスで起こった芸術運動で、自然の与え
　る瞬間的印象を表現することが大切だとする
　主義のこと」
dialogues.en:
"It is an art style orginating from France. It focuses on
sudden impressions from the brain to create pieces of art."
dialogues.text:
"It is an art style orginating from France. It focuses on
sudden impressions from the brain to create pieces of art."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.en: "...Correct."
dialogues.text: "...Correct."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「よかった……」
dialogues.en: "That's good..."
dialogues.text: "That's good..."

dialogues.jp:
俺が出した問題を全て答えることが出来たから
だろう。環が本当に嬉しそうに笑っている。
dialogues.en:
Every question I threw at her, was answered impeccably. She
seemed really happy at her work.
dialogues.text:
Every question I threw at her, was answered impeccably. She
seemed really happy at her work.

dialogues.jp:
心なしか、背後に後光さえ差して見える環を呆
然と見つめながら。
dialogues.en:
It was the first time I'd seen her smile so brightly,
unrestrained.
dialogues.text:
It was the first time I'd seen her smile so brightly,
unrestrained.

dialogues.jp:
「うーん、本当に覚えているとは。すごいな、
　環は」
dialogues.en: "Hmm, you really did memorize everything. That's amazing."
dialogues.text: "Hmm, you really did memorize everything. That's amazing."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「そんなことありません。要領がよくないから、
　そのまま覚えているだけで」
dialogues.en:
"It isn't really... if you can memorize the general points,
it's easier to remember everything."
dialogues.text:
"It isn't really... if you can memorize the general points,
it's easier to remember everything."

dialogues.jp: 環は遠慮がちに微笑んでみせる。
dialogues.en: Tamaki abashedly smiled in her reply.
dialogues.text: Tamaki abashedly smiled in her reply.

dialogues.jp:
「でも、結果的にそれが成績に結びついてるん
　だ。スゴイことじゃないか」
dialogues.en:
"Doing that still pretty much confirms a good score. It's
amazing."
dialogues.text:
"Doing that still pretty much confirms a good score. It's
amazing."

dialogues.jp: 「俺には、丸暗記なんて真似は到底出来ないよ」
dialogues.en:
"I couldn't possibly indiscriminately memorize everything
like that."
dialogues.text:
"I couldn't possibly indiscriminately memorize everything
like that."

dialogues.jp:
祝詞のように、といっても、その祝詞自体を覚
えてること自体が俺からすればすごい。
dialogues.en:
The fact that she can memorize all those ritual prayers is
already several steps above me.
dialogues.text:
The fact that she can memorize all those ritual prayers is
already several steps above me.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「そんなことないですよ。何度も読んでいれば、
　なんとなく頭に入ってくるものです」
dialogues.en:
"That's not true. The more times you read the textbook, the
easier it is to remember what you read."
dialogues.text:
"That's not true. The more times you read the textbook, the
easier it is to remember what you read."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「うーん」
dialogues.en: "Hrm."
dialogues.text: "Hrm."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「音で覚えるんですよ」
dialogues.en: "Even the sound of the pages being flipped."
dialogues.text: "Even the sound of the pages being flipped."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「余計に難しそうだな」
dialogues.en: "That's way too difficult."
dialogues.text: "That's way too difficult."

dialogues.jp:
つまりは、耳で聞いて、感覚で覚えろってこと
なんだろうけど、それができれば、苦労はしな
いな。
dialogues.en:
If I had such a brilliant memory that could recall the sound
of pages being flipped, I wouldn't be worrying now.
dialogues.text:
If I had such a brilliant memory that could recall the sound
of pages being flipped, I wouldn't be worrying now.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「これから『初恋』を覚えようと思うんですけ
　ど……」
dialogues.en: "I was thinking of memorizing "First Love" that way, now..."
dialogues.text: "I was thinking of memorizing "First Love" that way, now..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「は、『初恋』？　教科書に載ってたヤツ？」
dialogues.en: "Huh, "First Love"? That poem mentioned in the textbook?"
dialogues.text: "Huh, "First Love"? That poem mentioned in the textbook?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「はい」
dialogues.en: "Yes."
dialogues.text: "Yes."

dialogues.jp:
そういえば、詩の一部を空欄にして、それを埋
める問題を出すって言ってたよな。
dialogues.en:
That reminded me, it was said that there'd be a question
where you'd have to recite an entire verse from a poem...
dialogues.text:
That reminded me, it was said that there'd be a question
where you'd have to recite an entire verse from a poem...

dialogues.jp: 「やばい。俺、全然やってないぞ」
dialogues.en: "Gah, I definitely can't do that..."
dialogues.text: "Gah, I definitely can't do that..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉様」
dialogues.en: "Asakura-sama."
dialogues.text: "Asakura-sama."

dialogues.jp:
少しだけ、思い詰めたような、そんな表情を浮
かべて。
dialogues.en: She paused for a little, and spoke after some thought.
dialogues.text: She paused for a little, and spoke after some thought.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「……わたくしと、一緒に覚えますか？」
dialogues.en: "...Would you like to memorize it with me?"
dialogues.text: "...Would you like to memorize it with me?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「ほんとか？」
dialogues.en: "You mean it?"
dialogues.text: "You mean it?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「はい」
dialogues.en: "Yes."
dialogues.text: "Yes."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「ああ、暗記の女王様がついていてくれるなら、
　俺も覚えられるかも……」
dialogues.en:
"Ahhh, with the Goddess of Recollection guiding me, I might
just be able to..."
dialogues.text:
"Ahhh, with the Goddess of Recollection guiding me, I might
just be able to..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「七五調だから、覚えやすいと思いますよ」
dialogues.en: "We'd learn sentence by sentence."
dialogues.text: "We'd learn sentence by sentence."

dialogues.jp: そう言う環は、何だか嬉しそうに見えた。
dialogues.en: Her words were tinged with joy.
dialogues.text: Her words were tinged with joy.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「じゃあ、行きますよ」
dialogues.en: "Shall we begin?"
dialogues.text: "Shall we begin?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「よっしゃ」
dialogues.en: "Yes ma'am!"
dialogues.text: "Yes ma'am!"

dialogues.jp: 気合入れていくぞ！
dialogues.en: Time to get fired up!
dialogues.text: Time to get fired up!

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「『まだあげ初めし前髪の……』」
dialogues.en: "Like the beginning of the forelocks..."
dialogues.text: "Like the beginning of the forelocks..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「『まだあげ初めし前髪の……』」
dialogues.en: "Like the beginning of the forelocks..."
dialogues.text: "Like the beginning of the forelocks..."

dialogues.jp: 環の後に続いて、俺も暗唱しながら。
dialogues.en: I repeated after Tamaki.
dialogues.text: I repeated after Tamaki.

dialogues.jp:
（いつも何気なく聴いているけど、環の声って、
　何か癒されるよな……）
dialogues.en:
"(No matter how many times I hear it, I can't get over the
comfort I feel from her voice...)"
dialogues.text:
"(No matter how many times I hear it, I can't get over the
comfort I feel from her voice...)"

dialogues.jp: 俺はそう思った。
dialogues.en: I truly thought that.
dialogues.text: I truly thought that.

dialogues.jp:
やっぱり、巫女って人に安らぎを与えるものな
のかな。
dialogues.en:
People generally look to Miko for assurance, guidance, and a
sense of safety...
dialogues.text:
People generally look to Miko for assurance, guidance, and a
sense of safety...

dialogues.jp: それとも、環が持っている性格なのかな？
dialogues.en: Is that the trait that Tamaki possesses, as well?
dialogues.text: Is that the trait that Tamaki possesses, as well?

dialogues.jp: 奇怪な行動も多いけど……。
dialogues.en: Her behaviour may be strange at times...
dialogues.text: Her behaviour may be strange at times...

dialogues.jp: 可愛いと思う。
dialogues.en: But it adds to her cuteness as well.
dialogues.text: But it adds to her cuteness as well.

dialogues.jp: 環って、不思議だよなあ……。
dialogues.en: She's a mysterious one...
dialogues.text: She's a mysterious one...

dialogues.jp:
なんて。考えながら暗唱していたら、内容が全
く頭に入っていなかった。
dialogues.en:
Man. Thinking so much while reciting, I'm not remembering
anything at all.
dialogues.text:
Man. Thinking so much while reciting, I'm not remembering
anything at all.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「『問ひたまふこそこひしけれ』」
dialogues.en: "Meek as a lamb, I ask of you."
dialogues.text: "Meek as a lamb, I ask of you."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「『そこのけそこのけおうまがとおる』」
dialogues.en: "Something as a something, I ask of something."
dialogues.text: "Something as a something, I ask of something."

dialogues.jp: 環が首を傾げる。
dialogues.en: Tamaki shook her head.
dialogues.text: Tamaki shook her head.

dialogues.jp: ごめんな、俺には暗記は無理のようです。
dialogues.en: Sorry for having a crappy memory.
dialogues.text: Sorry for having a crappy memory.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「……朝倉様、朝倉様の初恋はいつでしたか？」
dialogues.en:
"...Asakura-sama, when did you encounter your first feelings
of love?"
dialogues.text:
"...Asakura-sama, when did you encounter your first feelings
of love?"

dialogues.jp: 不意に。
dialogues.en: Right out of the blue.
dialogues.text: Right out of the blue.

dialogues.jp: 環が質問を振ってくる。
dialogues.en: Tamaki threw that question at me from nowhere.
dialogues.text: Tamaki threw that question at me from nowhere.

dialogues.jp: 「初恋？」
dialogues.en: "My first love?"
dialogues.text: "My first love?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「そうだなぁ……。俺はあまりよく覚えてない
　な」
dialogues.en: "Well... I don't really remember..."
dialogues.text: "Well... I don't really remember..."

dialogues.jp:
もちろん、小さいときに女の子に『好きかも』っ
て気持ちを抱いたことはあるけど、今思えば友
情の延長だったんじゃないか、とも思う。
dialogues.en:
When I was small, I used to think everything I felt for
girls was love... but now, I feel it's more like an
extension of friendship.
dialogues.text:
When I was small, I used to think everything I felt for
girls was love... but now, I feel it's more like an
extension of friendship.

dialogues.jp:
本当に心から、誰かが好きで、その人のことが
忘れられない、というのとは違っていたから。
dialogues.en:
It's different from really having someone you love, someone
you can't stop thinking of, someone always in your heart.
dialogues.text:
It's different from really having someone you love, someone
you can't stop thinking of, someone always in your heart.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「初めて恋した時のドキドキって、きっと何年
　経っても薄れないんでしょうね」
dialogues.en:
"The feelings you get from your first love will surely
remain strong even as years pass..."
dialogues.text:
"The feelings you get from your first love will surely
remain strong even as years pass..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「かもしれないな……」
dialogues.en: "Perhaps..."
dialogues.text: "Perhaps..."

dialogues.jp: 正直、経験がないから、なんとも言えない。
dialogues.en:
Honestly, I've never truly experienced it, so I couldn't say
much.
dialogues.text:
Honestly, I've never truly experienced it, so I couldn't say
much.

dialogues.jp:
けれど、恋っていうのはそういうものな気がす
る。なんとなくだけど。
dialogues.en: Yet, my heart seemed to tell me that her words rang true.
dialogues.text: Yet, my heart seemed to tell me that her words rang true.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「わたくしも……」
dialogues.en: "I, as well..."
dialogues.text: "I, as well..."

dialogues.jp: 環は、言いかけて首を横に振る。
dialogues.en: But as she said that, she shook her head rapidly.
dialogues.text: But as she said that, she shook her head rapidly.

dialogues.jp: そして──。
dialogues.en: Then--
dialogues.text: Then--

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「でも、初恋は、実らないんですよね」
dialogues.en: "However, first love is never true anyway..."
dialogues.text: "However, first love is never true anyway..."

dialogues.jp: ぽつりとそう言った。
dialogues.en: She spoke slowly, pronouncing every syllable.
dialogues.text: She spoke slowly, pronouncing every syllable.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉様……」
dialogues.en: "Asakura-sama..."
dialogues.text: "Asakura-sama..."

dialogues.jp: 環が俺の瞳を見つめる。
dialogues.en: Her eyes gazed deeply into mine.
dialogues.text: Her eyes gazed deeply into mine.

dialogues.jp: 驚くほど真剣な瞳で、ドギマギする。
dialogues.en: Those serious eyes made me self-conscious.
dialogues.text: Those serious eyes made me self-conscious.

dialogues.jp: 俺の中の気持ちを見透かされたようで、戸惑う。
dialogues.en: I felt like she was seeing through my feelings.
dialogues.text: I felt like she was seeing through my feelings.

dialogues.jp: 環は一度唇を開き……キュッと閉じた後で。
dialogues.en: Tamaki opened her lips once... then closed it immediately.
dialogues.text: Tamaki opened her lips once... then closed it immediately.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉様は……」
dialogues.en: "Asakura-sama is..."
dialogues.text: "Asakura-sama is..."

dialogues.jp: そして、また環は口を紡ぐ。
dialogues.en: Her mouth shut firmly tight, again.
dialogues.text: Her mouth shut firmly tight, again.

dialogues.jp: 環は……彼女は、何を言おうとしたんだろう。
dialogues.en: Tamaki... what's that girl trying to say?
dialogues.text: Tamaki... what's that girl trying to say?

dialogues.jp: 初恋……。
dialogues.en: First love...
dialogues.text: First love...

dialogues.jp: 初恋は、実らない？
dialogues.en: First love is never true?
dialogues.text: First love is never true?

dialogues.jp:
もし、俺と環の『深い絆』が幼い頃のものだと
したら。
dialogues.en:
Maybe she's talking about that supposed "deep bond" we
have...
dialogues.text:
Maybe she's talking about that supposed "deep bond" we
have...

dialogues.jp:
お互い、覚えていないけれど、幼い頃の約束だ
としたら……。
dialogues.en:
She may know as much as me about it, but it's still a
promise of some sort when we were younger...
dialogues.text:
She may know as much as me about it, but it's still a
promise of some sort when we were younger...

dialogues.jp:
わからないからこそ、彼女は続きの言葉を言え
ないんじゃないだろうか。
dialogues.en:
I don't know what she's trying to convey, but I felt like I
couldn't let her continue.
dialogues.text:
I don't know what she's trying to convey, but I felt like I
couldn't let her continue.

dialogues.jp:
「初恋だって、実ると思うぞ。その恋が本当の
　恋ならさ」
dialogues.en:
"I think your first love would be just as true a love as any
other."
dialogues.text:
"I think your first love would be just as true a love as any
other."

dialogues.jp:
恋なんて、わからないくせに、わかったような
言葉を紡ぐ。
dialogues.en:
Despite knowing nothing about it, I just tried to say what I
thought.
dialogues.text:
Despite knowing nothing about it, I just tried to say what I
thought.

dialogues.jp:
環は、俺の言葉を聞いて、何かを感じたのか、
ほんの少しだけだけれど、淡い笑みを浮かべて
いた。
dialogues.en:
When Tamaki heard my words, whatever she was feeling, a tiny
smile crept onto her lips.
dialogues.text:
When Tamaki heard my words, whatever she was feeling, a tiny
smile crept onto her lips.

dialogues.jp: 初恋──か。
dialogues.en: First love, huh...
dialogues.text: First love, huh...

dialogues.jp: ◆余裕の環◆
dialogues.en: ◆The Composed Tamaki?◆
dialogues.text: ◆The Composed Tamaki?◆

dialogues.jp:
教室で環に会うと、テスト当日だというのに余
裕の表情を見せる。
dialogues.en:
I found Tamaki in the classroom on the day of the first
exams. She seemed composed and confident of them.
dialogues.text:
I found Tamaki in the classroom on the day of the first
exams. She seemed composed and confident of them.

dialogues.jp:
何か秘策があるのか尋ねたところ、教科書を全
部暗記しているらしい。
dialogues.en:
I tried to uncover her secret studying methods, but
apparently, she simply memorizes the entire textbook.
dialogues.text:
I tried to uncover her secret studying methods, but
apparently, she simply memorizes the entire textbook.

dialogues.jp:
一緒に島崎藤村の『初恋』の暗記をしていた途
中、環が俺に何かを｛き／訊｝こうとしてした。
dialogues.en:
We tried to memorize Shimazaki Touson's "First Love"
together, and she tried to ask me something.
dialogues.text:
We tried to memorize Shimazaki Touson's "First Love"
together, and she tried to ask me something.

dialogues.jp:
けれど、口を紡いでしまう。環は何を言おうと
していたんだろう。
dialogues.en:
But she decided against it. Wonder what she was trying to
say...?
dialogues.text:
But she decided against it. Wonder what she was trying to
say...?
